---
category: Job board
---
The task's lifecycle state as a dot and a label, read at a glance from across a list.

States and their meaning come from one table (`BoromTech.STATUS`): `open` (orange, available to claim), `assigned` (neutral, in progress), `changes` (danger), `submitted` (warning, waiting on us), `approved` (hollow green ring, passed but unpaid), `paid` (solid green). Approved and paid differ by the dot's fill, not only by color, so they stay distinct for color-blind readers.

Pills mean state only. Don't use the pill shape for tags or categories.
